description: A workbook for XlsxGenerator: what its info sheet says, and its sheets, each one table. Everything but `sheets` is optional.

title.description: The title: on the info sheet, in the printed page header and in the core properties.

subtitle.description: The subtitle: on the info sheet under the title, and the subject in the core properties.

description.description: What the workbook holds: on the info sheet, and the description in the core properties.

author.description: The author: on the info sheet, and the creator in the core properties.

date.description: The date shown on the info sheet and above every table. Default: today, from XlsxOptions.TimeProvider.

language.description: The language, a BCP 47 tag such as `en`, `de` or `de-CH`: it picks the texts the generator writes itself (XlsxOptions.Texts) and, unless XlsxOptions.Culture is set, the culture of the number and date formats. Default `en`.

marking.description: The classification marking: on the info sheet and in the printed page header, never in the properties. It can raise XlsxOptions.Marking but not lower it, like front matter.

classification.description: How confidential the workbook is. Values: "public": Not marked: the default, which shows nothing. "internal": For the organisation only: "Internal". "confidential": For named readers only: "Confidential".

brand.description: The name of the brand: `neutral`, the brand of XlsxOptions.Brand or one of XlsxOptions.Brands. Default: XlsxOptions.Brand.

sheets.description: The sheets, in order; the info sheet comes before them.

items.description: A sheet holding one table: a title and a description above it, the header row, the rows.

name.description: The sheet's name on its tab, by Excel's rules: 1 to 31 characters, none of `[]:*?/\`, not starting or ending with `'`, and unique ignoring case.

items.description: A column of a sheet's table: its header and the type of its values.

header.description: The text of the header row, and the name a formula refers to it by: `[Header]`.

type.description: What the values are, and so how they are shown. Default: "text"; for a column of formulas, "number", or "currency" when its formulas refer only to currency columns of one currency. Values: "text": Text, kept as written: `01234` stays `01234`. "number": A number with the culture's decimals and thousands separator. "integer": A whole number with the thousands separator. "currency": An amount with a currency symbol (`currency`). "percent": A share, stored as a fraction: `0.25` is shown as 25 %. "date": A date in the culture's short format. "dateTime": A date and time in the culture's short formats. "boolean": A truth value, which Excel shows as TRUE or FALSE in its own language.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of a "currency" column, such as `EUR`; its symbol is shown where the culture puts its own. Default: the culture's currency.

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point, 0 to 10, for "number", "currency" and "percent". Default: the culture's (the currency's for a currency of another country).

width.description: The width in characters, 1 to 255. Default: measured from the header and the values, 6 to 50.

align.description: The alignment. Default: text left, booleans centred, numbers and dates right. Values: "left": At the left. "center": Centred. "right": At the right.

total.description: The column's total in the totals row under the table, written as `SUBTOTAL` so that a filter changes it to the visible rows. Only "count" on a text or boolean column. Default: none. Values: "sum": The sum of the visible values: `SUBTOTAL(109, …)`. "average": Their average: `SUBTOTAL(101, …)`. "count": How many visible cells are not empty: `SUBTOTAL(103, …)`. "min": The smallest visible value: `SUBTOTAL(105, …)`. "max": The largest visible value: `SUBTOTAL(104, …)`.

title.description: The title above the table and in the info sheet's contents list.

description.description: The line under the title, and the text beside the sheet in the contents list.

totalsLabel.description: The label of the totals row, in the first column without a `total`. Default: GeneratedTexts.Total ("Total").

rows.description: The rows, each at most as many cells as there are columns; a short row is filled with empty cells.

items.description: One value of a row, in the order of the columns: a number (a percentage as a share, 0.12 for 12 %), a string (in a date column an ISO date such as "2026-03-15", in a dateTime column "2026-03-15T14:30:00"), true or false, null for an empty cell, or {"formula": "[Price]*[Quantity]"}.

formula.description: A formula in Excel's English form, with or without the leading '=': [Header] is the cell of the column with that header in the same row, {row} the row's number; A1 references are kept as written. Excel computes it on opening.

charts.description: The sheet's native charts on its table's cells, beside the table or each on a chart sheet of its own.

items.description: A native chart whose series refer to the cells of its sheet's table, so that changing a value changes the chart: the categories from one column, a series from each further column.

category.description: The header of the column whose values label the categories; any type. Numbers and dates keep their format on the axis.

series.description: The headers of the columns drawn as series, in order: each a number, integer, currency or percent column.

type.description: Upright columns, bars across, lines or areas. Default "column". Values: "column": Upright columns, clustered or stacked. "bar": Bars across, the categories down the left from top to bottom, clustered or stacked. "line": Lines with markers. "area": Filled areas, overlapping or stacked.

stacked.description: Columns, bars or areas stacked on each other rather than side by side or overlapping; lines ignore it.

unit.description: The unit of the values, shown with the value axis (`k`, `%`); the axis also shows the first series' number format.

source.description: Where the data comes from: a second, smaller line of the title, after GeneratedTexts.Source ("Source: Annual report").

placement.description: Beside the table, or on a chart sheet of its own after the table's sheet. Default "beside". Values: "beside": On the table's sheet, right of the table, 8 columns by 16 rows; further charts below it. "sheet": On a chart sheet of its own, right after the table's sheet, linked from the info sheet's contents.

sheetName.description: The name of the chart sheet, for "sheet", by the rules of `name`. Default: GeneratedTexts.Chart with the number of the chart sheet in the workbook ("Chart 1").
